description: Similarity hits of scripts/check-provenance.mjs that were read by hand (#295, docs/PROVENANCE.md). A hit is accepted when file, field and sha256 match and it is not longer than `tokens`; `where`, `lines` and `upstream` are hints only.

entries.reason: Same shape only: an ES import list ({ a, b, ... }) against a list of identifiers in C. No code is shared.

Seven consecutive int16 reads in the wire order of a CAS DATETIME (year, month, day, hour, minute, second, millisecond) with the JavaScript month made zero-based. The layout is the protocol's; the Date is built differently (toDate() with the session timezone, not setUTCFullYear/setUTCHours).
Six int16 reads of a CAS TIMESTAMP in wire order; same reasoning as parseDatetime().
Same shape only (NAME = number, ...): any enum of numbered names matches. The values are the CAS function codes; the names drop the CAS_FC_ prefix and only the codes the driver sends are listed.
Same shape only, matched against an unrelated enum (function codes): a list of numbered names. The values are the CCI_U_TYPE wire type codes.
Same shape only, matched against an unrelated enum (function codes). The values are the T_CCI_CUBRID_STMT statement codes.

entries.where: DATETIME bind value (writeBindValue and the zoned/array bind writers)
entries.reason: A run of writeShort(value.getX()) calls in the wire order of a DATETIME bind value. The order and widths are the protocol's; the date accessors differ (JavaScript Date, not java.time).
Seven writeShort(value.getUTCX()) calls in DATETIME wire order before the zone name; same reasoning.
